title: ReWorld: An Interactive World Model with Long-Horizon Memory
abstract: arXiv:2608.23565v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An interactive world model must follow the user's actions, remember the places it has shown, and stream in real time. The tension is structural: control wants a short horizon, memory wants an unbounded one. ReWorld separates the two during training and bounds them at inference. Mixed per-head attention windows confine most heads to the recent past while a small set of global heads attends over the entire history, and random head routing keeps either capability from binding to particular heads; random chunk dropping makes sparse histories in-distribution. At inference the whole past lives under a fixed budget: a bounded KV cache backed by a pose-indexed landmark bank, from which the model retrieves the landmarks nearest the current pose. translated_title: ReWorld：一种具有长时记忆的交互式世界模型
translated_abstract: 交互式世界模型必须遵循用户的操作、记住已展示的场景，并实时流式传输。这种张力在结构上是存在的：控制需要短视界，而记忆需要无界视界。ReWorld在训练期间将两者分离，并在推理时加以约束。混合的每头注意力窗口将大多数头限制在近期过去，而一小部分全局头则关注整个历史，随机头路由使任一能力不绑定到特定头；随机块丢弃使稀疏历史在分布内。在推理时，整个过去在固定预算下运行：一个有界KV缓存，由姿态索引的地标库支持，模型从中检索最接近当前姿态的地标。一个度量尺度对齐的数据引擎将八个来源——虚幻引擎渲染的飞越、游戏漫游和真实世界镜头——置于一个物理动作尺度上，因此相同的按键以相同方式移动相机。
tldr: ReWorld通过分离控制与记忆、使用混合注意力窗口和有界KV缓存，实现了交互式世界模型在实时流式传输中的长时记忆与高效推理。
en_tdlr: ReWorld achieves long-horizon memory and real-time inference in interactive world models by decoupling control from memory, using mixed attention windows and a bounded KV cache.
